title: A new foundation gives words their weight
meaning: You can discover misunderstood permission’s scope and give agreement dependable form, feeling your words’ significance anew.
text: The Tower in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in revealing a mistaken scope of permission underlying an answer. The Emperor in energy supports a wish to give agreement reliable form and definite boundaries. Judgement in emotions brings significance to meaning heard anew. Unexpected clarification can resonate deeply when a personal remark’s importance becomes understandable. Another foundation need not declare the whole earlier exchange wrong.

For example, “You can pass that on” was heard as permission to recount the entire conversation although only the meeting time was meant. The distinction becomes explicit. **A reliable word begins with meaning genuinely accepted**. You clarify what can be confirmed and hear a response. Personal words gain weight because their scope is no longer guessed. The moment need not become a solemn admission: actual understanding suffices that time information and personal content were not one permission.

Rigidity appears if clarification’s importance requires regulating every possible remark beforehand. Reliable form then becomes an impenetrable system while actual response disappears again. The constructive Emperor helps preserve an understandable commitment without imagined omniscience. You can name what is accepted and ask about something new; a word’s significance neither prohibits clarification nor proves respect for personal meaning through the number of conditions anticipated in advance.
